name: grid-golem
//: A blocky biped for the minecraft target. Authored Z-up (scene.json's frame is Blender-native Z-up): height is Z, legs rest on z=0 so `grounded` holds. Junctions OVERLAP by one pixel (1/16) rather than sharing a face plane — exactly how a Minecraft modeller avoids in-game z-fighting between elements; every coordinate still lands on the 1/16 grid. The showcase control: compiles clean AND lowers to a clean, standing Java block model.
